root_idea.summary: The root centers on hardness and dryness: something firm, smooth, dry, and resistant to yielding.
root_idea.development: From hard or dry material, the usage extends to barren land, a firestick that fails to produce fire, hairless or shining surfaces, withholding, and bodily non-emission such as little milk or sweat.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested nominal is presented under the normalized citation form صَلْدٌ.

senses.definition: A hard, smooth stone left bare and unable to produce vegetation.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَتَرَكَهُ صَلْدًا, describing the stone exposed when its covering is removed; the usage combines hardness and smoothness with barrenness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard and smooth, applied to stone, land or ground, a solid hoof, and other tough surfaces or objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may describe physical hardness and smoothness without implying barrenness in every context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Barren or unproductive, producing no plants or herbage; said of land, a place, or rugged hard ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the extended description of ground that yields no vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: So hard that it baffles a well-digger and resists his efforts; said of the rock or mountain encountered in a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rock or a mountain obstructing excavation by its hardness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a firestick or piece of wood, to give a sound but emit no fire; in Form IV, to make or cause this failure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is used literally of a failed attempt to produce fire and figuratively of unproductive means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardly, withholding, or refusing a request; to give nothing to an asker or to be found ungenerous when asked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes صَلَدَ السَّائِلَ, ‘he gave nothing to the asker,’ and the negative praise expression لَيْسَ بِمُصْلِدِ القَدْحِ for one who does not refuse when asked.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bald or hairless on the head or forehead; a bald area likened to smooth stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may refer to the hairless part of the forehead or to a head on which no hair grows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shining, gleaming, or glistening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often applied to a smooth or bald surface; the shining quality may be expressed independently as an adjectival meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To flow forth, in a rare reported usage said of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage is reported in a traditional expression and is distinct from the ordinary sense of shining or being smooth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of broth or milk, to contain little oily or greasy matter and much water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported special usage, explained as equivalent to يَصْلِتُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of canine teeth, to produce a grating sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of the sound made by the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clap with the hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional verbal expression describing hand-clapping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beast, to beat the ground with its forefeet while running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the animal’s manner of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a mountain-goat, to ascend a mountain; also of one who climbs a mountain out of fear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is associated with ascending or taking refuge on a mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wild cow or wild ox, to stand erect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare usage preserved in an attributed verse and its lexical explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that does not sweat or is slow to sweat; also one with little seminal fluid and slow impregnation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are reported physiological applications of the adjective to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hardy, strong, or enduring, said of a she-camel or horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes physical robustness and endurance in these animal expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel having little or no milk, including one that has given birth but has no milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of deficient milk production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, having little or no good in her, or being hard-hearted and without compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application to character and disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cooking-pot that is slow to boil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of slowness or resistance to a cooking vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Alone, apart from others, or separate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage describing isolation or separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk milked into a greasy vessel and consequently without froth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of milk lacking foam because of the vessel’s greasy condition.
